correctness.rationale: For each fixed plane S of F_q^3, structure matrices correspond to surjections V:F_q³->S; each kernel line has |GL2(q)| choices. When all normal-vector coordinates are nonzero, the coordinatewise symmetric-square map T_S is invertible even in characteristic two (cross coefficient ab, not 2ab); the q²+q+1 kernel quadratics split into q(q+1)/2 distinct-linear, q+1 double and q(q-1)/2 irreducible. The other 3q planes have rank(T_S)=2 and exactly q² admissible surjection kernels, all of distinct-linear type. This proves the stated three counts and probability. Independent exhaustive rank-two/steady-square multiplication and quadratic-factor counts over F2 and F3 reproduced totals (162,18,6) and (5040,768,576) by stratum. Tests over two fields support but do not prove all q.
